fato_historico: 1799: Jeanne Geneviève Labrosse becomes the first woman to jump from a balloon with a parachute.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to leap into new possibilities today. Much like the pioneer who first descended from the skies with grace, you may feel an urge to let go of old fears. It is a good time to trust your inner strength and consider that your unique courage is what carries you safely toward beautiful, unexplored horizons.
frase_do_dia: True growth begins the moment you decide to step into the unknown.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual intuition and hidden personal potential.
conselho: Trust your instincts and prepare for a rewarding jump into a new adventure.
